headline: Lithuania 2025 in Lean to the cent (OECD TW 2025 55/56 lines exact; 2022-2025 122/128 with the versioned NPD): the NPD, tested on all income, makes the statutory 15 % on dividends 24.8 % for most employees, puts the highest marginal rate on wages (49.3 %) between 12,456 and 28,647 EUR while the top band pays 38.98 %, and lets one more euro cost a two-child family 1,730 EUR of child benefit.
